movie_title: How does the Nobel Peace Prize work? - Adeline Cuvelier and Toril Rokseth

vocabulary.definition: regarded with deep respect and admiration
vocabulary.example: The Nobel Peace Prize has honored some of the most revered international figures in history.

vocabulary.definition: the forming of a theory or conjecture without firm evidence
vocabulary.example: Many assumptions about Alfred Nobel's creation of the peace prize are based on speculation.

vocabulary.definition: a person who believes that war and violence are unjustifiable
vocabulary.example: Bertha Von Suttner, an Austrian pacifist, influenced Alfred Nobel's interest in the peace cause.

vocabulary.definition: heads of universities or educational institutions
vocabulary.example: University rectors are among the eligible nominators for the Nobel Peace Prize.

vocabulary.definition: occurring after the death of the originator
vocabulary.example: The Nobel Peace Prize cannot be awarded posthumously, in accordance with the rules.
For many years, the Nobel Peace Prize was predominantly awarded to European and North American men.
